examples.title: Rainbow
examples.description: Paints a rainbow, a strip of grass and the sun in PMODE 3, the Dragon's four-colour graphics mode, with CIRCLE arcs and PAINT; press any key to return to the text screen.

examples.title: Is it a prime number?
examples.description: Asks for a whole number and either reports that it is prime or shows the smallest factor that divides it.

examples.title: Road race
examples.description: Steer the V along a winding road with the left and right arrow keys; leaving the road ends the race and shows the distance. Space races again and BREAK stops.
